thread:
Anya Patel: Starting canary rollout of inference-service v2.3.1 to 10% traffic. Will monitor error-rate and latency. Deploy initiated by @anya.

 deploy-bot: Deploy started for inference-service v2.3.1 -> canary (10%). Links: https://ci.internal/release/9876 :package:

 Marcus Li: getting paging noise, alert firing: `prod-cpu-high`? also seeing error-rate spikes on /v1/generate in us-west-canary :rotating_light:

 Sanjay Rao: @Marcus can you paste metric snippet? I want to see per-model error breakdown.

 Marcus Li: coming... logged a query: `sum(rate(request_errors[1m])) by (route, model_version)` returning a 4x jump for route=/v1/generate, model_version=unversioned

 Elaine Gomez: Wait 'unversioned' tag? That's new — instrumentation might be missing model_version tag in the canary rollout.

 Randall Chen: I can confirm traces show requests missing `model_version` label after upgrade. That would make our canary SLO dashboards aggregate incorrectly.

 incident-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-99 - High error-rate on canary; paging product on-call.

 Anya Patel: flipping feature flag to stop the rollout while we triage. Using FF service: `curl -X POST "https://flags.internal/api/toggle" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"flag":"inference_canary_v2","enabled":false}'` — will post results.

 Marcus Li: :thumbsup: Please also mute the noisy alert rule `canary-error-rate` for the next 15m to reduce chaff while we debug.

 oncall-bot: Alert `canary-error-rate` suppressed for 15m by Anya Patel.

 Sanjay Rao: root cause hypothesis: new runtime optimization lost model_version header propagation when request fanout happens. It surfaced only under canary traffic split because older traffic path includes header glue.

 Elaine Gomez: To confirm, running a direct test against canary instance: 
```
curl -sv 'https://canary.int/inference/v1/generate' -H 'Authorization: Bearer <redacted>' -d '{"input":"hello"}'
# check span tags for model_version
```

 Marcus Li: test shows header missing on backend, so alerts are genuine about missing tag leading to SLO burn, but customer impact unclear — errors are 5xx rate up ~1.8% in canary, overall prod <0.1%.

 Anya Patel: That's promising — limited to canary. Let's rollback the canary version back to v2.3.0 while we patch the instrumentation.

 Randall Chen: Rollback command run via deploy console. deploy-bot logs:
```
deploy-bot: Rollback initiated: inference-service -> v2.3.0 (canary 10%) by Anya Patel
deploy-bot: Rollback completed: canary traffic back to v2.3.0
```

 incident-bot: Incident updated: mitigated by rollback. Monitoring for error-rate reduction.

 Marcus Li: Error-rate back down to baseline within 2 minutes. SLO burn stopped. Customer-visible errors: small, maybe a handful of requests — Customer support notifications not needed but let's keep watching.

 Elaine Gomez: Action items: 1) Fix header propagation in runtime optimization patch 2) Add model_version dimension to canary SLO dashboard (missing) 3) Add a deploy-check that asserts span tags preserved for canary paths.

 Sanjay Rao: I'll open a follow-up ticket and include a minimal repro and a unit test. Ticket: https://jira.internal/browse/ENGINF-6421

 Anya Patel: Good postmortem notes. Thanks everyone for quick action — this shows the importance of per-dimension observability for canaries. Closing channel for now but will reopen if anything regresses. :white_check_mark:

 Randall Chen: :thumbsup:

 oncall-bot: Handoff: Marcus Li remains on-call for next 30 minutes monitoring. If anything else, page on-call team.
